title: tui/settled-prompt — v1
description: Declares the screen patterns that indicate the agent is idle and ready for a new prompt. Combined with `tui/spinner` (negated) and `tui/modal` (negated) by the builder to decide `idle`. Codex `❯ <model> · /shortcuts`, Claude `? for shortcuts` + `❯`, Antigravity `>` + `? for shortcuts` are all expressible.

regex.description: ECMAScript regex source. Matched within the scope window.

withFooter.description: Optional auxiliary substrings or regex sources that must also be present in the scope window for the prompt to count as settled. Use this to disambiguate from mid-stream prompt-like text.

pattern.description: Plain substring (when `kind` is omitted or `substring`) or regex source (when `kind` is `regex`).
